text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, approximately 2.23% of the property was affected by tree-cover loss in 2021. This corresponds to a loss area of 81.3 hectares out of the total asset area of 3643.5 hectares. The observed tree-cover loss was primarily in planted forests, with no native forest affected. The data is corroborated by multiple sources, including the University of Maryland's Global Forest Change dataset and the European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020.
